description: Labelled RAG evaluation set. 'evidence' is an exact substring of the document that contains the answer (used to check retrieval independently of chunking). 'answer' is a list of groups; a reply is correct if it contains at least one term from every group (case-insensitive, whole-word, commas inside numbers ignored). Off-topic questions are general knowledge asked while the document is loaded; they have no evidence. 'split' is fixed: thresholds are tuned on 'dev' only and results are reported on 'test'.
